title: Seeing Cab Calloway's band in Flint with his father
summary: His father took him to Flint to hear Cab Calloway, where he watched his idol Chu Berry and was struck by Hilton Jefferson's 'Body and Soul' solo.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Well, I had records, my father-- you know--then every once in a while he'd take me out. He took me to Flint (Michigan) one time to hear Cab (Calloway) in person and I heard Hilton Jefferson...there was all the other guys in the band, but I was saxophone conscious. So, I'll never forget this, there was a dance in Flint and my father took me over there and there was Cab's band and there was Chu Berry, one of my idols, and there was Hilton Jefferson. So they played 'Body and Soul' and Hilton Jefferson got up and played so gorgeous...I thought Chu was going to take the solo, but Hilton Jefferson took the solo and--I'm tellin' ya--the guys in the band applauded, so people in the audience applauded. It was just wonderful and I was so glad to meet Hilton Jefferson and make some records with him, later on. He was so...not only was he a great saxophonist, but he was a gentleman, you know, a nice person.
So this trip to Flint to see Cab's band...
That was with my father, he did that for me.
...was that the first time that you had really seen one of your heroes?
What else do you remember about that particular show?

Well, I know Cab was out in front; he was singin' and doin' his thing, but I listened for the precision and the rhythm was beautiful, but I had my eye on Chu and then, after I heard Jeff, then I had my eye on him. But that was the highlight of that evening for me, 'cause my father knew I loved Chu Berry, see?
So just you and your father went?
Well, there was some other people, I don't remember, you know. I think it was a couple of other people went with us, yeah.
Did anyone that you went with and anyone that you knew then know any of the people personally, in the band?
So it was just a matter of going in and...
...you never had a chance to meet any of them?
